title: Change tier
summary: The Change tier dialog opened from the tier control on licenses.detail: moving Priya Raman's automatic Education license up to Studio (every changed limit, old and new, what stays, and why the move sticks), and down to Free, where a warning says her next sign-in moves it back to Education because an Access rule still covers her.
compare: Two dialogs on the board, side by side from 1280px.
Move to: the tier select with its rank (Studio 1 of 5, Free 5 of 5) and 'Now on Education, 3 of 5.'

What changes: a card of rows, each the old value struck and the new one added: Devices 4 → 12 (10 from Studio, 2 from a seat pack), Release tracks stable → stable, beta, Duration Ends Sep 14, 2027 → Lifetime, Includes recording, 4 decks → recording, stems, 4 decks.

Moving up also says what stays (offline days 14 set on this license, fingerprint Normal, the 3 add-ons) and why it sticks (still an Automatic grant; Studio is the top tier). Cancel and Move to Studio.

Moving down: Devices 4 → 3 ('She has 3, so none is signed out'), Duration → Lifetime, Includes → 2 decks, no recording; a warning 'Her next sign-in moves it back to Education' / 'Verified email domain example.edu gives Education. To keep her on Free, change that rule first.'; Open Access, Cancel and Move to Free.
Phone: the rows' values wrap under their chips; buttons stack with the primary on top.

designReview.reviewer: Spacing and content pass against the products.overview and products.home references, all four sizes in both themes
designReview.verdict: Spacing and content pass: kit dialogs with kv-rows and diff chips; 0 screen spacing.

findings.issue: A custom diff table (7 spacing declarations) that ran past the dialog on phone.
findings.resolution: Kit only: .kv-rows with .diff-old/.diff-new and .source, which wrap on a narrow card; .icon-list for what stays.

findings.issue: The hint under Move to repeated the new tier's limits the table then listed; the stays line listed every add-on by name.
findings.resolution: The hint says where it is now; what changes is said once.

findings.issue: Redundant lines, split footer, wrapping delta chips.
findings.resolution: 'Now on Education, 3 of 5.' removed; Unchanged and Still an Automatic grant are one line; the foot is .dialog-foot.std, so on phone Cancel sits beside the primary with Open Access above the pair. The diff rows keep the kit's old-to-new chips; they wrap inside the value column.

findings.issue: Relabel the primary 'Move to Free anyway' and use a caution button style for the moving-down variant.
findings.resolution: declined: It changes a button label and the kit's button style, which is a product decision, not spacing.
